ja176:1.1: The fool, who resorts to the tree branches –
ja176:1.2: Leader of men, wisdom’s not found in him –
ja176:1.3: Threw away a whole fistful of cow peas,
ja176:1.4: Seeking out one cow pea that had fallen.
ja176:2.1: Such are we, O king, those who (live) amongst others, having great greed,
ja176:2.3: We lose a lot through a little,
ja176:2.4: like the monkey with the cow pea.
